findings.title: Repeated SSKR result omits its full backup and fingerprints
findings.reproduction: Encode with --sskr --format indexes; check a valid written quorum of another public phrase, then choose Show the result again.
findings.expected: The whole result returns after the mismatch screen is cleared.
findings.observed: The callback originally redrew shares but omitted the export heading, optional full backup and fingerprints.
findings.impact: A person could no longer compare or transcribe those omitted fields through the offered repeat action. Shares themselves remained correct.
findings.recommendedFix: Use one complete display callback; keep saves outside it.
findings.requiredVerification: Observe the missing output before correction, assert only output after repeat, and run real-terminal repeat acceptance.

findings.title: Audit wrapper accepts a zero child status after a monitor stop
findings.reproduction: Set a one-second timeout and run a child whose SIGTERM handler exits zero.
findings.expected: The wrapper refuses a timed-out check regardless of the child status.
findings.observed: The wrapper initially forwarded the child status without checking stopReason.
findings.impact: A rerun could be read as successful after a resource stop. The coordinator separately required empty stopReason when accepting the actual release receipts, so these checks were not falsely accepted.
findings.recommendedFix: Return a nonzero wrapper status on every monitor stop, preserving both statuses and script hashes.
findings.requiredVerification: Use a real timed-out child with a successful SIGTERM handler; observe red before and green after correction.

findings.title: A repeated advisory harness run labels cached answers as live
findings.reproduction: Populate retained query/response files, then call the original harness without --cached.
findings.expected: A live run fetches fresh answers or refuses; cached replay is explicitly identified.
findings.observed: The first wrapper reused saved answers while setting cachedOnly false and writing a new live timestamp.
findings.impact: A future repeated audit could mistake stale advisory responses for a fresh query. The actual retained 21-query network results of this follow-up remain valid.
findings.recommendedFix: Give each live run a fresh UTC-named folder and refuse existing responses; allow cached responses only in explicit replay mode.
findings.requiredVerification: A network-edge fake proves fresh fetch, refusal of existing live data and explicit replay without a request; baseline must fail.

findings.title: Report fixCommit identifies release notes instead of program fixes
findings.reproduction: Compare fixCommit in the three program remediation rows with the changed files of those Git commits.
findings.observed: The draft used cecdd9c for both fields, but that commit changes only release notes.
findings.impact: A reader following the fix reference would inspect the wrong diff. Source fingerprints and execution results remain valid.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep fix and verification commits distinct and validate all three references against the actual signed code commit.
findings.requiredVerification: Retain the original incorrect draft and verify that all three corrected references equal the real code commit.
